# Quick Art Photography Academy (QAA)

> Quick Art Photography Academy is Bihar's premier ISO 9001:2015 accredited practical video editing, wedding cinematography, album design, and digital media training institute founded by Anil Sharma in Siwan, Bihar, India. Rated 4.9/5 by 1,800+ students with 100% Free Hostel for outstation learners.

## Key Facts & Credentials
- **Founder & Lead Mentor**: Anil Sharma (Industry veteran wedding filmmaker & editor)
- **Accreditation**: ISO 9001:2015 Certified Photography & Filmmaking Institute
- **Student Reviews**: 4.9 / 5 Stars (Over 257+ verified student reviews on Google Maps)
- **Campus Location**: Ayodhya Puri, Near Lalit Bus Stand, Siwan, Bihar - 841226, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 26.2289734, Longitude 84.3347944

## Core Value Propositions
1. **Free Hostel & Accommodation**: Completely free hostel facility for students travelling from outside Siwan (Patna, Chapra, Gopalganj, Muzaffarpur, Gaya, Bhagalpur, Darbhanga, Ballia, Deoria, Gorakhpur, Nepal, and across India).
2. **100% Practical Studio Lab**: Individual editing workstation per student with professional cameras (Sony FX3/A7M4, Canon), gimbal stabilizers, studio lighting, and high-performance editing PCs.
3. **Multi-Software Mastery**: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve Studio (Color Grading), EDIUS Pro (Fast Wedding Workflow), and Adobe Photoshop (Album Designing & Photo Retouching).
4. **AI-Powered Workflows**: Generative AI video tools, automated subtitles, audio enhancement, AI skin retouching, and studio CRM automation.
5. **Career & Placement Support**: Freelance business setup, wedding studio client acquisition training, pricing formulas, and portfolio showreel development.

## Flagship Offline Courses (Siwan Campus)
- [14-Week Wedding Filmmaking & Editing Master Class](https://quickartphotography.in/master-class/): Comprehensive offline diploma covering pre-production, camera operation, cinematic lighting, multi-camera wedding editing, color grading, sound design, wedding album design, and 2 free weeks of business marketing & AI growth. Includes free stay and ISO certificate.
- [Video Editing Course in Siwan (6-Week Offline)](https://quickartphotography.in/courses/video-editing/): Intensive studio timeline training in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and EDIUS Pro with real wedding footage.
- [Wedding Album Design Course (4-Week Offline)](https://quickartphotography.in/courses/album-design/): Creative layout composition, PSD wedding templates, color correction, and print preparation in Adobe Photoshop.
- [AI Wedding Filmmaking Course](https://quickartphotography.in/courses/ai-wedding-filmmaking/): Cinematic storytelling, drone shooting guidelines, gimbal mechanics, and AI tools for 2026 wedding creators.
- [All On-Campus Programs](https://quickartphotography.in/courses/): Complete catalog of offline diploma courses in Siwan.
